# Combine all pages and sum amounts for requests within the 10-day window (2023-05-24 to 2023-06-02 inclusive)
all_requests = requests_page + requests_page_1 + requests_page_2
start_date = datetime(2023, 5, 24)
end_date = datetime(2023, 6, 2, 23, 59, 59)
total = 0
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(req['created_at'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    # Convert to naive datetime (assuming same timezone as current_date)
    created_naive = created.replace(tzinfo=None)
    if start_date <= created_naive <= end_date:
        total += req['amount']
print(total)
